notes: Baseline for scripts/benchmark-imports.mjs (cold import wall-time per package entry, in ms).
Regenerate on a CI-class runner with: npm run benchmark:imports:update
Entries missing here are reported as 'new' and never fail the gate, so this file must be populated once for the gate to be active.

budgets defines the per-entry-point performance budget: maxImportMs is the cold import wall-time ceiling and maxDeltaRatio is the allowed regression ratio versus the recorded baseline. An entry fails CI when its measured import time exceeds maxImportMs or regresses beyond maxDeltaRatio.
